data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 时间机器旁的禁断试验
data.description: 电话微波炉发出低沉的蜂鸣，昏暗的实验室内只有仪表盘微弱的光芒。红莉栖坐在工作台边沿，双腿微启挂在对方腰侧，散开的白大褂与凌乱的衬衫勾勒出极致的娇媚。
data.location: cluttered lab workbench surrounded by glowing vacuum tubes and oscilloscopes
data.action: seated on sturdy wooden workbench edge with open white coat and unbuttoned shirt, legs hooked around partner waist, crying out in breathless unbridled pleasure
data.lighting: vibrant neon amber and cyan nixie tube numeric glow flickering in darkness
data.mood: intense breathless abandonment, forbidden sci-fi lab passion, overwhelming physical climax
data.promptProse: Sitting on the lab workbench with disheveled shirt and open coat, Kurisu clings tightly in sheer ecstatic abandonment under glowing oscilloscope lights.
